:: Government e-Marketplace: As per Gr No. SPO-102015-691093-CH dated: 01.10.2018 of I&M Department, the Government e-Marketplace Portal is to be used for all item purchases by all Govt. Departments, Heads of Departments, Boards, Corporations, Nigams. If purchase items are not available on the Government e-Marketplace Portal, it is necessary to take the prior approval from Principal Secretary, Industries & Mines Department or Industries Commissioner for purchase of the items through e-Tendering by submitting the details of initiated process and non availability of items on the Government e-Marketplace Portal with proper justifications
:: (n)Procure Portal Requirement : (1) Computer with Windows (with full Administrative rights, All upgrades and .Net Framework-2) (2) Internet Explorer version 7.0 and above (3) Legally valid class 3 Digital Signature Certificate. i.e. 2 Separate Certificates-Signing & Encryption under Indian Root CA chain.
